architecture_summary: A full-stack monorepo using Nx containing an Angular 21 frontend SPA with Ionic components and a NestJS 11 backend API. The application follows a modular architecture with event-driven design using NestJS EventEmitter. Authentication is handled via JWT tokens with Passport. Data persistence uses Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL. The UI library is documented with Storybook. Includes background job processing with Bull queues and scheduled tasks with NestJS Schedule. Multiple data providers integrate for market data including AlphaVantage, CoinGecko, and Google Sheets.
key_patterns: Custom Guards and Decorators for RBAC
